title: Good Features Are Far Outweighed by Bad Features
text:
Good Features Are Far Outweighed by Bad Features. The VORNADO VS-410 ESSENTIAL FABRIC STEAMER comes with a big lint brush, a fabric brush attachment, a travel case, and an 8-foot cord with an attached Velcro strap (for securing the wrapped-up cord). The steamer heats up quickly (in about 2 minutes); it delivers a fairly substantial amount of steam; and it stays cool on the bottom (so it won't burn or set fire to any flat surface you set it on when it's hot).

However, these good features are far outweighed by the many bad features of this product:

*** The steamer is designed only for steaming items that are hanging up--it strongly prefers to be operated in a vertical position. If you want to steam an item laid flat on a bed, and hold the steamer horizontally (like an iron), the steamer spits water droplets even when not overfilled.

*** The water tank capacity is inadequate. On a "max fill", my steamer delivered steam for only 8 minutes (not the promised 10 minutes). Worse, when you open the top to refill the tank, there is still some steam inside, even after the steamer has stopped delivering steam and has gone quiet. (The instructions do say that you should turn the steamer off and let it cool completely before refilling the tank.)

*** The water tank fill window is badly placed. It's difficult to fill the steamer exactly to the "max fill" line, because you can't easily see the window while you're filling the tank at a faucet. Worse, you cannot check the water level when you're actually steaming a garment without aiming the steam directly at your face!

*** The power button is badly placed. Located on the top of the handle, the power button turns off at the slightest touch. My steamer kept turning off when I was simply trying to steam out creases, until I realized that I was hitting the power button as I moved the hand holding the steamer.

*** For a travel steamer, this one is kind of heavy. The steamer and fabric brush attachment alone weigh 1 lb. 11.5 oz.; add the lint brush and travel bag, and the whole thing weighs 1 lb. 15 oz. (almost 2 lbs.).

*** The power does not shut off automatically when the water tank is empty.

*** The 8-foot cord is just barely long enough for a steamer intended to be used on hanging garments.

*** The steamer needs cleaning every 3-6 months with Vornado CleanCycle crystals (two packets supplied with steamer).

My plan was to use this steamer for blocking hand-knit garments, which need to be steamed to give them a finished look. However, it's a really bad choice for knitters! The steam output time is very short, and the steamer doesn't work well in a horizontal position.

My old [[ASIN:B00005OU01 Sunbeam Garment Steamer]] (weighing 1 lb. 5.1 oz. complete with brushes and travel case) is easier to use, and includes the ability to deliver extra steam; it's a better all-around fabric steamer (but apparently discontinued by Sunbeam). This Vornado steamer was a real disappointment, because I'm very happy with my other Vornado products (an oscillating fan, a room air circulator, and a humidifier). I rate this steamer at 2 stars ("I don't like it" on the official Amazon scale).

At home or traveling, you can rely on the VS-410 Essential Fabric Steamer to keep your wardrobe looking its best. It provides powerful, continuous steam to quickly and easily remove wrinkles from all types of clothing. And it’s dual voltage making it a perfect companion when traveling internationally.
Equipped to tackle your steam needs — on the go.
Easy to use one button control.
7 powerful steam holes provide for 10 minutes of continuous steam.
Soft bristles provide extra cleaning power for refreshing fabrics.
Provides a finishing touch for fabrics.
Neatly store the unit and accessories in one convenient bag.
CleanCycle™ cleaning crystals cut through mineral build-up for longer product life.
Quality products demand premium support. Vornado’s support team is committed to your satisfaction.
Backed by an industry-leading 5 year warranty. You can rest assured that your Vornado will perform for years to come.
Vornado has long been recognized as the leader in air movement techologies including air circulators, heaters, humidifiers and air purifiers. Now we are setting a new standard in steam.

Our steam products have been engineered to work better, last longer, and be easier to use. With the introduction of steam, we’ll continue to deliver the unrivaled quality, performance and customer support that you’ve come to expect from Vornado.

IMPORTANT INTERNATIONAL DISCLAIMER: This item is built to meet U.S. voltage requirements and may not function properly when used in conjunction with external devices that alter or convert voltage or frequency of electricity. Improper use or shipping the product outside the U.S. will void all warranties.
